# CODEship Academy

> CODEship Academy is a Canadian children's coding, AI, and STEM education
> company (operating since 2023), headquartered in Oshawa, Ontario and serving
> families across Durham Region. Its flagship offering is a K-8 progression of
> four coding levels — Explorers (K-1, visual blocks), Builders (grades 2-3,
> HTML/CSS), Developers (grades 4-5, JavaScript), and Engineers (grades 6-8,
> Python + AI + cybersecurity) — each 4 semesters plus a capstone project.
> CODEship also offers K-8 Math Tutoring and English & Reading Tutoring
> alongside the coding programs. Every program is a flat CAD $129 per semester
> (8 weekly classes, one class per week). Classes run in person on Saturdays in
> Oshawa (serving Oshawa, Whitby, Courtice, Bowmanville, and Clarington), or
> live online across Canada (Tuesdays for Explorers/Builders, Thursdays for
> Developers/Engineers, 4-6 PM ET). In-person classes in Toronto, Mississauga,
> Brampton, Markham, Scarborough, Vaughan, Milton, Calgary, Edmonton,
> Vancouver, and Surrey are waitlist-only for now, while online remains open in
> all of them. CODEship also offers a separate online-only program for families
> in Guyana. Tagline: "Dream. Code. Achieve." Curriculum alignment to
> provincial (Ontario, BC, Alberta, Québec) and Guyana NGSA-related frameworks
> is described as "aligned to / maps to / supports" — CODEship is not endorsed
> or approved by any ministry of education.

## Programs (Canada, K-8 journey)

- [Explorers (K-1)](https://www.codeshipacademy.com/programs/explorers): visual block coding
- [Builders (Grades 2-3)](https://www.codeshipacademy.com/programs/builders): HTML & CSS
- [Developers (Grades 4-5)](https://www.codeshipacademy.com/programs/developers): JavaScript
- [Engineers (Grades 6-8)](https://www.codeshipacademy.com/programs/engineers): Python, AI, cybersecurity
- [Math Tutoring (K-8)](https://www.codeshipacademy.com/programs/math-tutoring): number sense to pre-algebra
- [English & Reading Tutoring (K-8)](https://www.codeshipacademy.com/programs/reading-tutoring): phonics to essays
- [Programs overview & journey map](https://www.codeshipacademy.com/programs)
- [Weekly classes](https://www.codeshipacademy.com/programs/weekly-classes)
- [Camps](https://www.codeshipacademy.com/programs/camps)
- [School workshops](https://www.codeshipacademy.com/programs/school-workshops)
- [AI & robotics](https://www.codeshipacademy.com/programs/ai-robotics)
- Price: flat CAD $129 per semester (8 weekly classes) for every program, in-person or online.

## Locations

- [All locations](https://www.codeshipacademy.com/locations)
- In-person Saturday classes: Oshawa (serving Durham Region — Oshawa, Whitby, Courtice, Bowmanville, Clarington)
- In-person waitlist (online open): Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Markham, Scarborough, Vaughan, Milton, Calgary, Edmonton, Vancouver, Surrey
- Online: open across Canada — Tuesdays (Explorers, Builders) and Thursdays (Developers, Engineers), 4-6 PM ET

## Guyana (online-only)

- [Online coding classes](https://www.codeshipacademy.com/gy/online-coding-classes)
- [Math, English & coding](https://www.codeshipacademy.com/gy/math-english-coding)
- [NGSA & digital skills](https://www.codeshipacademy.com/gy/ngsa-digital-skills)
- [Computer classes for kids](https://www.codeshipacademy.com/gy/computer-classes-for-kids)
- [Online STEM classes](https://www.codeshipacademy.com/gy/online-stem-classes)
- Price: GYD $20,000 per semester. Online only — no in-person Guyana locations.
